name: SynthSimpliEval
description: A static synthetic benchmark for text simplification featuring simplified sentences generated by models of varying sizes, designed to provide reliable evaluation with high inter-annotator agreement and reflect expected trends in model quality.
reputation: A small synthetic benchmark for text simplification that is useful for controlled evaluation but not widely adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on text simplification with synthetic data and LLMs-as-a-Jury ratings to improve evaluation reliability.
